people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

translations.web: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
translations.bsb: So the field and its cave were deeded by the Hittites to Abraham as a burial site.
translations.kjv: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
translations.asv: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.
